commands.command:
set -e
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/fleet-https-server >/dev/null <<'FLEET_PY'
#!/usr/bin/python
from BaseHTTPServer import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
import ssl

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        body = "node2 HTTPS service secured by Fleet Internal CA\n"
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

server = HTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8443), Handler)
server.socket = ssl.wrap_socket(
    server.socket,
    keyfile="/etc/pki/tls/private/node2.key",
    certfile="/etc/pki/tls/certs/node2.crt",
    server_side=True)
server.serve_forever()
FLEET_PY
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/fleet-https-server
sudo chown root:root /etc/pki/tls/private/node2.key /etc/pki/tls/certs/node2.crt
sudo chmod 0600 /etc/pki/tls/private/node2.key
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/fleet-https.service >/dev/null <<'FLEET_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Fleet Internal CA HTTPS service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/fleet-https-server
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
User=root
Group=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
FLEET_UNIT
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable fleet-https.service
sudo systemctl restart fleet-https.service
sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8443/tcp
sudo firewall-cmd --add-port=8443/tcp
sudo systemctl is-active fleet-https.service
sudo systemctl is-enabled fleet-https.service
sudo firewall-cmd --query-port=8443/tcp
